europe_now.title: Crimean Bridge and Kyiv Crossings Struck in Escalating Conflict
europe_now.summary: The Crimean Bridge partially collapsed following an operation that Ukrainian leadership described as unprecedented. Simultaneously, overnight missile strikes by Russia targeted major bridges and infrastructure in Kyiv, causing disruptions to heating and water supplies.

sources.headline: 🔴 Live: Kerch Bridge to occupied Crimea closed after Ukrainian strikes collapse road section
Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine

europe_now.title: Poland's Central Bank Freezes Constitutional Court Accounts
europe_now.summary: Poland's central bank has frozen the accounts of the constitutional court amid an ongoing dispute over the institution's leadership. This financial measure underscores escalating institutional tensions within the country.

sources.headline: Poland’s central bank freezes constitutional court’s accounts amid leadership dispute

top_stories.title: European Migration and Asylum Policy Shifts
top_stories.summary: Several European countries are advancing collaborative plans to send rejected asylum seekers to external facilities in Rwanda. The European Union continues to explore international partnerships as traditional deportation mechanisms face persistent hurdles.

sources.headline: 5 European countries aim to send rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda

top_stories.title: Regulatory Actions on Corporate Compliance in Europe
top_stories.summary: The European Commission has issued another warning to Temu over the sale of illegal products, risking significant financial penalties. Meanwhile, Irish data protection regulators successfully intervened to halt X from utilizing agent-gathered data for artificial intelligence training.
